title: mqtt receipt v1
description: What the host publishes to <prefix>/receipts/<ulid> (QoS 1, RETAINED) for EVERY envelope (fired, refused, failed, unparseable). THICK on purpose: the far end learns the outcome from the receipt alone — status, allowlisted headers, capped body + full-body digest, latency — plus the X-8-Witness reafference. Retained so a far end that was away still finds its answer. It travels a broker the host does not own: response headers are allowlisted (Content-Type, Content-Length, X-8-*), a slot-authenticated call publishes only the body's sha256 unless the policy opts in, and the host's Policy may withhold body/headers entirely (egress).

contract.description: trace.Version — the wire contract version the host speaks.

decision.description: The host's verdict. fired=false means the atom never left the host.

policy.description: Which gate decided: validate | expiry | auth-slot | closed | <policy name>.

egress.description: The outbound gate applied to this receipt (absent = default: capped body for plain calls, allowlisted headers, digest-only for auth_slot calls).

body.description: Include the capped body for calls WITHOUT an auth_slot.

authenticated_body.description: Explicit opt-in: include the body of a slot-authenticated call. Default false = body_len + body_digest only.

call.description: Echo of a fired CALL. Headers are deliberately absent — after auth_slot resolution they hold a credential.

channel.description: Echo of a fired CHANNEL command.

status.description: HTTP status of the afferent leg at the witness (the command's own result is in body).

body_len.description: Full body length before the cap.

body_digest.description: sha256 hex of the FULL body.

body.description: Capped at the host's max-body; absent when egress.body=false, and ABSENT for a slot-authenticated call unless egress.authenticated_body (the digest is always present).

headers.description: ALLOWLISTED response headers only, first value each: Content-Type, Content-Length, X-8-*. Set-Cookie, WWW-Authenticate and every other server header are never echoed. Absent when egress.headers=false.

authenticated.description: True when the CALL was fired with a host-side auth_slot credential (so body is digest-only by default).

witness.description: The reafference the 8 collector stamped on the response, verbatim.

node.description: The host's node name (its MQTT client id).

route.description: How the receipt itself travelled — the app-routing knobs made visible.
